dedupe_keys.name: cabildo insular de tenerife road datasets

description: Cabildo Insular de Tenerife: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cabildo Insular de Tenerife. Coverage: Cabildo Insular de Tenerife. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Incidencias en carreteras de Tenerife; Operaciones de limpieza y mantenimiento en carreteras de Tenerife; Estaciones de aforo por tramos de la red de carreteras de Tenerife; Intensidad diaria de tráfico de Tenerife (2026). Formats seen: JSON, PLAIN, CSV, GEO%2BJSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
